title: ChickenParachute
description: Chickens on lead while falling down, slow you down
body:
# ChickenParachute
Required Plugin: https://modrinth.com/plugin/kotlinplugins
- Chickens on lead while falling down, slow you down by providing levitation effect.  
- The purpose of this plugin is to create illusion of useful parachutes through chickens on lead.
- Check out other plugins: https://modrinth.com/user/Winlyps
